function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of custom event specifications that define custom events within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_inactive.description: A flag indicating whether to include inactive event specifications in the results.

category_filter.description: Filter the event specifications by the given category name.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieve a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system. This includes details such as event identifiers, names, and descriptions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_disabled.description: Whether to include disabled event specifications in the summary.

filter.description: A filter term to apply to the event names or descriptions. For example, 'error' to filter events related to errors.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieves details for a list of provided event specification IDs, including both built-in and custom event specifications. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: A list of event specification IDs for which details are being requested.

include_custom.description: Flag to determine whether custom event specifications should be included in the response.

include_built_in.description: Flag to determine whether built-in event specifications should be included in the response.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specification
function.description: Retrieve the specification for a built-in event based on its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the built-in event specification.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all built-in event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: An array of unique identifiers for the built-in event specifications.
